evidence.note: Charcoal serif title on white with soft, low-opacity blue blurred blobs; calm and single-hued.
Grey arrows plus one blue and one dark-red stroke on white cards; pale-blue check fills. Brights used as strokes and fills only.
'Misaligned reinforcement:' label set in dark red text on a white card: coloured text, but on a neutral ground, not glaring.
Blue-outlined agent dots and grey lines on a light grey panel; a small red lock badge is the only warm accent.
Blue, black and red dot fills with a matching legend on light grey; three-colour coding stays restrained, with no bright-on-bright pairing.
White cards, charcoal and grey text, small blue bullet dots; blue accent eyebrows and nav highlight are consistent across all slides.
Charcoal 'Thank you' on white with the same soft blue blobs as the title.

rationale: The deck uses charcoal on white with a single blue accent and a sparing dark red for misalignment, applied mostly as strokes, dot fills and badges, which matches the pass anchor's restrained palette. The only coloured text (blue eyebrows and nav, one dark-red label) sits on neutral white grounds and never pairs a bright with another bright. No glaring or clashing combinations appear in any step.
